glosses: книжн., уничиж. лишённый простоты, вычурный, манерный, стремящийся произвести впечатление значительности и т. п.

examples.text: Ему смешным и претенциозным казалось их общее пристрастие к разным эгреткам, шарфикам, огромным поддельным камням, к перьям и обилию лент: в этом сказывалась какая-то тряпичная, безвкусная, домашнего изделия роскошь.
Для полноты обзора упомянем ещё ряд трудов князя Федора Долгорукова, замечательных только тем, что это претенциозные, невежественно составленные компиляции, полные грубых опечаток.
Стихи были ужасные, — плоские, пёстрые, зловеще претенциозные.
Здесь вся его плюгавая наружность: и крохотный носик, и пошлые усики, и претенциозная шутовская одежда.
В Казани стоит сейчас на кладбище могила генерала В. И. Джугашвили, с претенциозной надписью, сделанной Машей, — «Единственному».

glosses: Motivated by an inappropriate, excessive, or unjustified desire to impress others.

examples.text: Her dress was obviously more pretentious than comfortable.

I recall the height of comfort attained by the green-cushioned "first" with starched white antimacassars and a pretentious grey floor mat on which it seemed a sacrilege to stand, as it was embellished with the North Western conception of Britannia, complete with trident.

glosses: Marked by an unwarranted claim to importance or distinction.

examples.text: Their song titles are pretentious in the context of their basic lyrics.
The station (1840) was originally Cheltenham but the more grandiose Cheltenham Spa since 1925, which feels a bit pretentious as the town has never allowed itself to assume such airs and graces.
The affected products had to be recalled.
He spoke with an affected English accent.
The affected articulation of his opinions made it challenging to discern his true stance.
He drove over last Saturday with this English babe that’s in this new picture he’s writing. She was pretty affected, but very good-looking.

Jones […] was easily prevailed on to satisfy Mr Dowling's curiosity, by relating the history of his birth and education, which he did, like Othello. […] Mr Dowling was indeed very greatly affected with this relation; for he had not divested himself of humanity by being an attorney.
an affected equation

glosses: Resulting from a mostly negative physical effect or transformation.
Someone affected, as by a disease.

examples.text: Affecteds felt that they get conflicting orders from superiors more frequently than did nonaffecteds […]. Affecteds were more frequently bothered by feelings of a sharp increase in their workload than nonaffecteds […].

glosses: simple past and past participle of affect

examples.text: The thunderstorm affected the compass, and we got lost.

glosses: Qui a des prétentions ; qui est désireux d’attirer l’admiration d’autrui.

examples.text: Cette gamine vicieuse et prétentieuse est la fille d’une grosse commère qui tenait, naguère, une fruiterie dans les environs du Barbès.
Grimpèrent au premier étage d'une prétentieuse babel de métal, suppositoire par quoi la civilisation parisienne avait cru enchoser Dieu
Albert est un trou de balle prétentieux. Son visage estampillé cinquante ans trahit une récente plastie des bajoues, il sourit en permanence de toutes ses facettes dentaires,[…].

glosses: Où il y a de la prétention, de l’affectation, de la recherche.

examples.text: Il a le ton bien prétentieux. — Il utilise un style vraiment prétentieux.
Les écrivains ne sont-ils pas des vaniteux, des prétentieux ? dit Marie-Josée.

Mistral reprendra la formule en la transformant : « Qui a vu Paris, mais n'a pas vu Cassis, n'a rien vu. » « C'est comme ça, commente Robert Ode, que les Cassidains se sont fait une réputation de prétentieux ! »
